states.work.taken.context: The value under the states listing's Work column on an ordinary state, where an owner takes work up.

states.work.waiting.context: The value under the states listing's Work column on a state that waits on somebody outside the workbench, where no owner takes work up.

next.awaiting-outside.context: Printed beside a state that offers no card because it waits on somebody outside the workbench, in place of next.none, which says only that nothing is ready.

refusal.dinah.awaiting-outside.text: Zustand {detail} wartet auf jemanden außerhalb der Werkbank, und dort wird keine Karte gehalten oder aufgenommen
refusal.dinah.awaiting-outside.context: The sentence printed after the refusal name dinah.awaiting-outside. {detail} carries the state the refusal is about.

refusal.dinah.awaiting-outside.next.text: ; gib die Karte zuerst frei, falls du sie hältst, oder schiebe sie weiter, sobald die Antwort da ist
refusal.dinah.awaiting-outside.next.context: Spliced onto refusal.dinah.awaiting-outside as the next step. The two ways forward are the same whichever act was refused.

states.work.none.context: The value under the states listing's Work column on a state where no owner takes work up, which is an intake state, a done state and a dinah.buffer. A state that waits on somebody outside reads states.work.waiting instead, because that value also says who is being waited on.

next.no-taker.context: Printed beside a state that offers no card because no act could take one up from there, in place of next.none, which says only that nothing is ready. A done state holding four ready cards prints this one.

next.take.claim.context: The value under the offers listing's Take column on a card an owner takes up where it stands. It names the command a reader types, so it reads as the act rather than as a sentence about it.

next.take.pull.context: The value under the offers listing's Take column on a card that leaves by a pull into the state beyond, because nobody takes work up where it stands. It names the command a reader types.

check.claim-where-no-work-is-taken.context: A check finding: no card is held at a state where no owner takes work up. {detail} carries the state, and the finding's own path names the card. The acts that would create the condition afresh are refused, so a card reported here was written before this build.

check.kind-out-of-position.text: Zustand {detail} trägt eine Art, die seine Stelle im Fluss nicht zulässt
check.kind-out-of-position.context: A check finding: an intake state stands first, a done state stands in the run of done states at the end of the flow, and a dinah.buffer stands in neither place. {detail} carries the state, and the repair is an edit to workbench.md or to the state's own state.md.

check.unknown-kind.text: Zustand {detail} trägt eine Art, die dieses Werkzeug nicht umsetzt, und wird als work-Zustand gelesen
check.unknown-kind.context: A check finding: a state carries a kind under a layer's prefix that this build does not implement. {detail} carries the state. CORE-STATE-12 requires such a state to be read as though its kind were work, and the sentence says so because nothing else tells a reader what happened.
